title: Trend line splits the range by day, week, month or quarter correctly
pre_body:
Preconditions

  1. User: you are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. Location: you are in a location (workplace) with more than two years of invoices, so Revenue has a value in every period.
  3. Data: you know how to set a custom range on the Revenue tile: click its range pill, click a start day and an end day in the calendar, check the "Range: N days" readout at the bottom, then click Apply.
